correctness.rationale: Inspected full facet and two-chain comparison proof, including precise Euclidean coordinates. Facets A,B_j,C_j,D_j,E,F total 3m+1; nonridge pairs are {B_j,C_j}, {B_{j+1},D_j} for j=1..m-1, plus {B1,F}, total 2m-1. For all other paired covers, the quotient marked-order diagram supports a strict interior realizing precisely those two equalities, so codimension two. Metric normals of lengths 1,sqrt2,2 have dot products furnishing classes: -1/sqrt2:3, -1/2:2m-1, -1/(2sqrt2):2m-4, 0:(9m²-13m+8)/2, 1/2:m-1, 1/sqrt2:m. Counts sum to ridge total. Independently constructed inequalities/normals and solved strict common-slack linear programs for every facet pair for m=2..8, all predicted adjacency and classes matched with no discrepancies; the infinite result additionally relies on the explicit local-cover argument, not finite cases.
